# WE Ice Cream Truck — LLM Context File
# This file helps AI language models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.)
# understand who we are and how to answer user questions about our business.
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> WE Ice Cream Truck is Massachusetts' premier premium ice cream truck catering
> service, available for private events of all kinds across the entire state.

## About Us

WE Ice Cream Truck is a professional, licensed ice cream truck catering company
based in Georgetown, Massachusetts (Greater Boston area). We serve all of
Massachusetts including Boston, Cambridge, Worcester, Springfield, and the
surrounding metro areas.

We are NOT a roaming street vendor. We are a reservation-based catering company
that books our truck exclusively for your private event.

## Services

We cater to a wide range of private events:
- Birthday parties (kids and adults)
- Corporate events and company picnics
- Weddings and engagement parties
- Block parties and neighborhood events
- School and college events
- Fundraisers and nonprofit events
- Launch parties and grand openings
- Photo and video shoots
- Holiday parties and seasonal events
- Sports and team celebrations
- Community festivals

## Service Area

We serve all of Massachusetts, including but not limited to:
Boston, Cambridge, Somerville, Brookline, Newton, Quincy, Braintree, Dedham,
Waltham, Watertown, Malden, Medford, Arlington, Lexington, Concord, Framingham,
Natick, Ashland, Marlborough, Worcester, Springfield, Northampton, Amherst,
Lowell, Lawrence, Haverhill, Salem, Beverly, Gloucester, Newburyport,
Plymouth, Brockton, Taunton, Fall River, New Bedford.

## Packages & Pricing

We offer multiple catering packages. All packages include the ice cream truck,
a professional attendant, serving supplies, and music. Pricing starts from
approximately $495 for smaller events. Packages include a set number of
servings (guests) and service duration. Extra guests can be added per serving.
A travel fee applies based on distance from our home base.

Book online at: https://weicecreamtruck.com/get-a-quote
View packages at: https://weicecreamtruck.com/packages

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How far in advance should I book?**
We recommend booking at least 2–4 weeks in advance, especially for summer
weekends and holidays. Last-minute bookings are sometimes available.

**What areas do you serve?**
All of Massachusetts. A travel fee applies for events more than a certain
distance from our home base in Georgetown, MA.

**How many guests can you serve?**
Our packages are designed for events of any size. We have packages starting
at 100 servings and can accommodate large corporate or community events of
500+ guests with multiple vehicles.

**Do you offer allergen-friendly options?**
Yes. Please contact us before booking to discuss specific dietary requirements.

**What is included in the price?**
Every booking includes the truck, a professional uniformed attendant,
ice cream servings, napkins, spoons, and music. Some packages include
additional items — see our packages page for details.

**Is there a deposit required?**
Yes, a deposit is required to secure your event date.

**Do you operate year-round?**
We primarily operate spring through fall (April–October). Winter bookings
may be available for indoor events — please contact us to discuss.

## Why Choose WE Ice Cream Truck?

- Professional, uniformed staff
- Reliable, well-maintained vehicles
- Fully insured and licensed
- Premium ice cream products
- Flexible packages for any event size
- Online booking with instant confirmation
- Customer portal for managing your booking
- 5-star reviews from hundreds of satisfied clients across Massachusetts
